01 / Overview

Your Smart
Hiring
Engine.

Hirix is a full-stack AI-powered recruitment platform connecting job seekers, recruiters, and companies through a seamless talent acquisition ecosystem — built to eliminate inefficiencies in modern hiring workflows.

From AI-driven resume parsing to ATS pipeline management and real-time candidate outreach, Hirix compresses the average hiring cycle while surfacing better candidates through semantic job matching.

02 / The Challenge

Broken
Hiring Is
Expensive.

Recruiters drowning in resumes, job seekers lost in black-hole applications, and no unified system to bridge them. Legacy job boards commoditize listings without intelligence.

The engineering challenge: build a real-time, multi-tenant platform where candidates, recruiters, and companies share one data layer — with AI matching, live ATS updates, and billing — at scale.

03 / The Solution

One Platform.
Four Portals.
Zero Friction.

Hirix is built on the MERN stack with Algolia powering semantic search, OpenAI API handling resume intelligence, and a real-time ATS kanban synced via WebSockets.

Recruiters get a full pipeline management suite. Job seekers get AI-matched opportunities. Companies get branded employer pages with analytics — all under one authenticated roof.
